title: You came to Sicily to eat. Stay to cook.

brief.audience: American travellers planning a stay in Sicily who want to do something with their hands, not only see it.
brief.objective: Sends to travel companions, then cooking class availability requests.
brief.hook: A feeling, not a service: eating is why you came, cooking is why you stay. It promises the guest a place at the counter.

the chef's hands lifting fresh pasta, cooking side by side

brief.hypothesis: A cover about learning to cook earns more sends than one about a dish. Success: sends >= 1% of reach.

caption:
RistHome is a hands-on cooking class in Palermo, Sicily, in the kitchen of Chef Giacomo Napolitano.

📍 Small groups, English spoken. You cook side by side with the chef.

🍽 Then you eat what you cooked.

Former Gambero Rosso chef. 5.0 on Google with 101 reviews.
